info.name: USPTO Database Status Trademark Search API

params.name: keyword
params.description: The trademark keyword or phrase to search for

params.name: searchType
params.description: Type of search to perform. Use 'active' for active trademarks only, or 'all' for both active and inactive marks.

items.docs: Searches active and inactive trademarks in the USPTO database by keyword. Returns matching trademarks with their current status, registration numbers, owner details, and goods/services classifications. Supports pagination for large result sets.
